reason: B offers the more physically grounded and testable intervention: trace boron has relevant prior support for improving grain-boundary cohesion in a BCC refractory HEA, and the proposed microscopy-controlled experiment can verify both boride formation and performance. Its irradiation-sink claim and >20% ductility prediction are insufficiently supported and its temperature notation is inconsistent, but A relies on questionable BCC stacking-fault-energy reasoning and does not explain how substitutional vanadium would create additional defect sinks.
